title: OrchestrateState
description: Per-task state for /orchestrate. Written by the planner at <workspace>/state.json after each spawn and handoff. Adapted from Cursor's state.schema.json minus Slack/cloud fields.

attention.description: Operator-visible drift entries. Append-only; also streamed to user during ticks.

adHoc.description: True if spawned outside plan.tasks (operator-injected). Not auto-spawned by reconcile loop.

agentId.description: Agent tool's returned agentId. Used for lineage (parentAgentId) and SendMessage.

parentAgentId.description: Spawning planner's agentId. For subplanner trees.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path to the worker's worktree, returned by Agent tool with isolation=worktree.

branch.description: Worker's actual branch name. Returned by Agent tool as worktreeBranch.

startingRef.description: The ref the worker reset to before working. Set from plan.json or auto-set for verifiers.

verification.description: Verification verdict on this task. For workers/subplanners: self-reported. For verifiers' targets: written by planner from verifier's handoff (overrides self-report).

failureMode.description: Set when status=error. Drives retry policy in references/handoffs.md.

handoffPath.description: Relative path from <workspace>/ to the central handoff copy.

note.description: Short operator-readable note (e.g. 'cancelled by operator', 'session interrupted').
